institutions: Institut Pluridisciplinaire Hubert Curien, CNRS-IN2P3, Strasbourg

parameters.name: aFC0
parameters.description: a^0_FC scalar flavor-changing coupling matrix, Eq. (5) line 1; benchmark [1,3]=[3,1]=a=0.1

parameters.name: bFC0
parameters.description: b^0_FC axial scalar flavor-changing coupling matrix, Eq. (5) line 1; benchmark all b = 0

parameters.name: aFC1
parameters.description: a^1_FC vector flavor-changing coupling matrix, Eq. (5) line 2; benchmark [1,3]=[3,1]=a=0.1

parameters.name: bFC1
parameters.description: b^1_FC axial vector flavor-changing coupling matrix, Eq. (5) line 2; benchmark all b = 0

parameters.name: aqSR
parameters.description: a^q_SR down-quark coupling matrix of varphi, Eq. (5) line 3; benchmark [1,2]=- [2,1]=a=0.1 (antisyymmetric, epsilon forces it)

parameters.name: bqSR
parameters.description: b^q_SR axial down-quark coupling matrix of varphi, Eq. (5) line 3; benchmark all b = 0

parameters.name: afSR
parameters.description: a^{1/2}_SR up-quark to chi coupling vector of varphi, Eq. (5) line 4; benchmark component 3 = a = 0.1

parameters.name: bfSR
parameters.description: b^{1/2}_SR axial up-quark to chi coupling vector of varphi, Eq. (5) line 4; benchmark all b = 0

parameters.name: taqSR
parameters.description: tilde a^q_SR four-fermion coupling matrix of tildevarphi, Eq. (5) line 5; scenario V benchmark [1,3]=[2,3]=a=0.1

parameters.name: tbqSR
parameters.description: tilde b^q_SR axial coupling matrix of tildevarphi, Eq. (5) line 5; benchmark all b tilde = 0

parameters.name: tafSR
parameters.description: tilde a^{1/2}_SR four-fermion up-quark to chi coupling vector of tildevarphi, Eq. (5) line 6; scenario V benchmark components [1,2]=a=0.1

parameters.name: tbfSR
parameters.description: tilde b^{1/2}_SR axial coupling vector of tildevarphi, Eq. (5) line 6; benchmark all b tilde = 0

parameters.name: aqVR
parameters.description: a^q_VR down-quark coupling matrix of X, Eq. (5) line 7; benchmark [1,1]=a=0.1

parameters.name: bqVR
parameters.description: b^q_VR axial down-quark coupling matrix of X, Eq. (5) line 7; benchmark all b = 0

parameters.name: afVR
parameters.description: a^{1/2}_VR up-quark to chi coupling vector of X, Eq. (5) line 8; benchmark component 3 = a = 0.1

parameters.name: bfVR
parameters.description: b^{1/2}_VR axial up-quark to chi coupling vector of X, Eq. (5) line 8; benchmark all b = 0

lagrangian_terms.name: Lkinphi
lagrangian_terms.expression: DC[phibar, mu] DC[phi, mu] - Mphi^2 phibar phi

lagrangian_terms.name: LkinV0
lagrangian_terms.expression: -1/2 FS[V0bar, mu, nu] FS[V0, mu, nu] + MV0^2 V0bar[mu] V0[mu]

lagrangian_terms.name: Lkinvphi
lagrangian_terms.expression: DC[vphibar, mu] DC[vphi, mu] - Mvphi^2 vphibar vphi

lagrangian_terms.name: Lkintvphi
lagrangian_terms.expression: DC[tvphibar, mu] DC[tvphi, mu] - Mtvphi^2 tvphibar tvphi

lagrangian_terms.name: LkinX
lagrangian_terms.expression: -1/2 FS[Xbar, mu, nu, cc] FS[X, mu, nu, cc] + MX^2 Xbar[mu,cc] X[mu,cc]

lagrangian_terms.name: LFC
lagrangian_terms.expression: phi (uqbar.aFC0.uq + uqbar.bFC0.Ga[5].uq) + V0[mu] uqbar.aFC1.Ga[mu].uq + V0[mu] uqbar.bFC1.Ga[mu].Ga[5].uq + HC[phi (uqbar.aFC0.uq + uqbar.bFC0.Ga[5].uq) + V0[mu] uqbar.aFC1.Ga[mu].uq + V0[mmu] uqbar.bFC1.Ga[mmu].Ga[5].uq]

lagrangian_terms.name: LSR
lagrangian_terms.expression: Eps[cc1,cc2,cc3] vphi[cc1] aqSR[ff1,ff2] bar[CC[dq]][sp,ff1,cc2].dq[sp,ff2,cc3] + Eps[cc1,cc2,cc3] vphi[cc1] bqSR[ff1,ff2] bar[CC[dq]][sp,ff1,cc2].Ga[5].dq[sp,ff2,cc3] + vphi (uqbar.afSR.chi + uqbar.bfSR.Ga[5].chi) + HC[Eps[cc1,cc2,cc3] vphi[cc1] aqSR[ff1,ff2] bar[CC[dq]][sp,ff1,cc2].dq[sp,ff2,cc3] + Eps[cc1,cc2,cc3] vphi[cc1] bqSR[ff1,ff2] bar[CC[dq]][sp,ff1,cc2].Ga[5].dq[sp,ff2,cc3] + vphi (uqbar.afSR.chi + uqbar.bfSR.Ga[5].chi)]

lagrangian_terms.name: LSRt
lagrangian_terms.expression: Eps[cc1,cc2,cc3] tvphi[cc1] taqSR[ff1,ff2] bar[CC[dq]][sp,ff1,cc2].uq[sp,ff2,cc3] + Eps[cc1,cc2,cc3] tvphi[cc1] tbqSR[ff1,ff2] bar[CC[dq]][sp,ff1,cc2].Ga[5].uq[sp,ff2,cc3] + tvphi (dqbar.tafSR.chi + dqbar.tbfSR.Ga[5].chi) + HC[Eps[cc1,cc2,cc3] tvphi[cc1] taqSR[ff1,ff2] bar[CC[dq]][sp,ff1,cc2].uq[sp,ff2,cc3] + Eps[cc1,cc2,cc3] tvphi[cc1] tbqSR[ff1,ff2] bar[CC[dq]][sp,ff1,cc2].Ga[5].uq[sp,ff2,cc3] + tvphi (dqbar.tafSR.chi + dqbar.tbfSR.Ga[5].chi)]

lagrangian_terms.name: LVR
lagrangian_terms.expression: Eps[cc1,cc2,cc3] X[mu,cc1] aqVR[ff1,ff2] bar[CC[dq]][sp,ff1,cc2].Ga[mu].dq[sp,ff2,cc3] + Eps[cc1,cc2,cc3] X[mu,cc1] bqVR[ff1,ff2] bar[CC[dq]][sp,ff1,cc2].Ga[mu].Ga[5].dq[sp,ff2,cc3] + X[mu] uqbar.afVR.Ga[mu].chi + X[mu] uqbar.bfVR.Ga[mu].Ga[5].chi + HC[Eps[cc1,cc2,cc3] X[mu,cc1] aqVR[ff1,ff2] bar[CC[dq]][sp,ff1,cc2].Ga[mu].dq[sp,ff2,cc3] + Eps[cc1,cc2,cc3] X[mu,cc1] bqVR[ff1,ff2] bar[CC[dq]][sp,ff1,cc2].Ga[mu].Ga[5].dq[sp,ff2,cc3] + X[mmu] uqbar.afVR.Ga[mmu].chi + X[mmu] uqbar.bfVR.Ga[mmu].Ga[5].chi]

lagrangian_terms.name: LTotal
lagrangian_terms.expression: Lkinphi + LkinV0 + Lkinchi + Lkinvphi + Lkintvphi + LkinX + LFC + LSR + LSRt + LVR
